name: EMBL ARISE2 Postdoctoral Fellowship (Research Infrastructure Scientists)
funder: European Molecular Biology Laboratory (EMBL), co-funded by MSCA COFUND
amount: EMBL postdoctoral fellow salary (monthly, by duty site, with annual increases) + social security and family allowances
other_rules: PhD held or defended by the deadline
prior experience in technology or method development relevant to EMBL research infrastructures
prior EMBL association no more than 12 months in the 3 years before the deadline
notes: Trains technology and infrastructure scientists (imaging, structural biology, bioinformatics services etc.). About 17 fellowships per call. 2026 call ran 30 Jun to 30 Sep 2026; interviews late November. Up to 2 host groups and 3 referees. Check whether further calls are planned (contact arise2@embl.org).
